items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: That wasn't me. No relation? No. No relation.

ctx.x: Yeah. And I was in my teens then, you know. Yeah. It was just, just, uh, 18th Wednesday had just passed

about then. Can you tell me more about your act? Just, I know you sang. All I know is the record that you made with Punch. And one other question I wanted to ask while I think of it. There was a record with Louis Armstrong. I tried to get every record that Armstrong ever made. And there was one with a Baby Mac singing. Now, was that you? That little Baby Mac. That wasn't me. No relation? No. No relation. No relation.
I wondered. Well, now, uh, uh, we, uh, uh, in 1914, that's the first time we supposed to come up north,
